title: huperzia reflexa
intro: Huperzia reflexa, commonly known as Tiger's Tail or Toothbrush Plant, is a species of evergreen shrub in the Lycopodiaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its potential to inhibit cancer cell growth, reduce inflammation, and improve cognitive function. The therapeutic actions of Huperzia reflexa include its ability to act as a neuroprotective agent, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which may contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease. The bioactive constituents of Huperzia reflexa include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenes, particularly huperzine A, which is responsible for its therapeutic effects.
